metadata.title: Book
metadata.description: Booking, customers and growth for beauty businesses.

home.title: Book
home.tagline: Get booked, manage your customers, and grow.

auth.signupSubtitle: Start with your name and email. Telegram and Google work too.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.

errors.invalid_input: Check the form and try again.
errors.email_taken: That email is already registered. Try logging in.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errors.not_configured: Telegram login is not set up yet.
errors.invalid_payload: Telegram login could not be verified.

account.title: Your account
account.noBusinesses: You have not set up a practice or salon yet.

onboarding.title: How will you use Book?
onboarding.subtitle: You can add another path later. Pick the one that fits you now.
onboarding.independentBody: Create your personal page and take bookings under your @handle.
onboarding.independentFormSubtitle: Choose a handle and tell customers what you do.
onboarding.salonTitle: I own a salon or studio
onboarding.salonBody: Create a business page, then invite staff when you are ready.
onboarding.salonFormSubtitle: Pick a name and a page address for your business.
onboarding.employeeBody: Join with an invitation from your owner or manager.
onboarding.employeeWaiting: Ask your salon for an invitation link.
onboarding.employeeWaitingHint: When you open their link while signed in, you will join their team. Searching for a salon to request to join comes later.
onboarding.handleHint: Shown as @handle. Letters, numbers and hyphens only.

errors.invalid_input: Check the form and try again.
errors.handle_reserved: That handle cannot be used. Try another.
errors.slug_taken: That page address is already taken.
errors.slug_reserved: That page address cannot be used. Try another.
errors.already_has_independent: You already have an independent practice.
errors.phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number, for example 0911 23 45 67.
